title: Environmental Factors
description: Environmental Factors (protection treatments, drainage, weather and tank sealing) as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is the environmental zone (temperature, humidity, fluids, sand and dust) of the installation identified?
Are corrosion risks from dissimilar materials identified?
Are fluid traps and drainage needs identified?
Are protective treatments and finishes selected for the environmental zone?
Is water and fluid drainage provided in the preliminary layout?
Are sealing needs (weather, fuel tank, fay surfaces) identified?
Are drainage and fay-surface sealing provided at low points?
Are all finishes and sealants specified by Finish Specification records?
Are environmental qualification requirements met or planned for bought-in equipment?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
